'''Keepers''' were specially trained [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssins]] who served as caretakers and guards of the [[Sanitarium]] on [[Nathema]], which [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] used to [[Prison/Legends|imprison]] and experiment on powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Stub}}

Keepers appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' '''Chapter 7: Into the Void'''.
